scripts.text: Khh ha ha ha ha ha ha.
That little rookie was knocked out by my one blow!
scripts.translation: 那个小菜鸟被我一拳打倒了！

scripts.text: Those arrogant fellows deserve a bitter lesson.
scripts.translation: 那些傲慢的家伙该好好吃点苦头。

scripts.text: How dare a little rookie attack you, boss!
scripts.translation: 小菜鸟竟敢袭击您，老大！

scripts.text: Khhha ha ha ha ha ha!!!!
One more cup of beer, here!!!
King Crab!!! I will follow you forever!!
Ha ha ha ha ha ha ha!!!!
Hey! Right here!!! One more cup of beer!!!
What are you doing? My boss's cup is already empty! Come quickly!
scripts.translation: 你在干什么？老大的酒杯已经空了！快点过来！

scripts.text: Yes, I will bring it right away.
Too slow!!! Who do you think my boss is? Huh!?
scripts.translation: 太慢了！！！你知道我老大是谁吗？啊！？

scripts.text: K k k k k. That's enough.
That cute girl seems to be scared of you!
scripts.translation: 那个可爱的姑娘好像被你吓到了！

scripts.text: Hey lady~ We are not scary people~~
scripts.translation: 喂，姑娘～我们可不是坏人哦～～

scripts.text: I've been watching you, making a ruckus like you own this place.
scripts.translation: 我一直在看着你们，在这里吵吵嚷嚷，真把这儿当自己家了。

scripts.text: It's too noisy. So if you want to say that nonsense again, go home.
scripts.translation: 太吵了。要是还想说那些废话，就回家去说。

scripts.text: I don't know who you are but you must've lost your mind!
scripts.translation: 我不管你是谁，你肯定是疯了！

scripts.text: Do you have any idea who my boss is?!!
This is the famous King Crab!!!
scripts.translation: 这位可是大名鼎鼎的蟹王！！！

scripts.text: Who can decimate entire armies with his fist!!!
scripts.translation: 他一拳就能击溃整支军队！！！

scripts.text: You do all the dirty things like your dirty face.
scripts.translation: 你就像你那张脏脸一样，只会干些下流勾当。

scripts.text: You're just a thug satisfying your desires.
scripts.translation: 你不过是个满足自己欲望的恶棍。

scripts.text: How dare you say those things?
Just because you're a girl doesn't mean I'll just let it go.
scripts.translation: 别以为你是女人，我就会放过你。

scripts.text: Huh! The boss is really mad!
I can beat you up with one blow...
scripts.translation: 我一拳就能把你打趴下...

scripts.text: Hey! How dare you use violence against a lady!?
Oh, I'm glad to hear that.
scripts.translation: 哦，听你这么说我就放心了。

scripts.text: I won't attack first because I'm in the middle of training.
scripts.translation: 我正在修行，所以不会先动手。

scripts.text: It's not a big deal. It's okay.
scripts.translation: 没什么大不了的，不用放在心上。

scripts.text: Are you going back to your lodging?
If it's okay with you, can I deliver you a meal?
scripts.translation: 如果你不介意的话，我可以给你送一份饭吗？

scripts.text: Oh, you don't really need to.
Just a slice of bread and warm soup will be enough for me.
scripts.translation: 一片面包和热汤就够了。

scripts.text: Then, I've got to say goodbye. Bye.
How come a little rookie knocked me out! Me! The great King Crab...
scripts.translation: 怎么会被一个小菜鸟打倒！我可是大名鼎鼎的蟹王啊...

scripts.text: Boss... Are we really past our prime now?
scripts.translation: 老大...我们真的已经不行了吗？

scripts.text: I hate those noisy and impolite customers!
scripts.translation: 我讨厌那些吵闹又没礼貌的客人！

scripts.text: I hope there is someone who can scold them for me.
scripts.translation: 真希望有人能替我教训他们。

scripts.text: I really appreciate you, {0}, for helping me a while ago.
scripts.translation: {0}，刚才真的非常感谢你出手相助。

scripts.text: Ah, the person we saw before?
scripts.translation: 啊，就是之前见到的那个人吗？

scripts.text: She has been staying in this village for days,
scripts.translation: 她已经在这个村子里住了好几天，

scripts.text: Although she is a woman like me, she was so cool!
scripts.translation: 虽然她和我一样是女人，但她实在太帅了！

scripts.text: Aaahh~ That beautiful and imposing figure...
scripts.translation: 啊啊～那美丽又威风的身影...

scripts.text: I should cook right away and then bring the meal to the Inn. Aaahh~
scripts.translation: 我得马上做好饭送到旅馆去。啊啊～

scripts.text: If you still don't know where to stay, please use ^f57d7dthe Inn at the upper side of this building^000000.
scripts.translation: 如果你还没找到住处，可以去^f57d7d这栋建筑上方的旅馆^000000。

scripts.text: Now that the customers have become a little quiet.
I am the person who was at the pub a while ago.
scripts.translation: 我就是刚才在酒馆的那个人。

scripts.text: Don't bother me, just go away!
Please, I just want to talk.
scripts.translation: 拜托，我只是想和你谈谈。

scripts.text: Don't ignore me, just talk to me.
Just for a moment, isn't it okay?
I'm not here to hurt you.
How could you treat someone who came to your door so badly?
scripts.translation: 你怎么能这样对待登门拜访的人？

scripts.text: I thought that you must have practiced martial arts and I came here to meet you.
scripts.translation: 我猜你一定练过武术，所以特地来找你。

scripts.text: But seeing that you stood me up outside like this...
scripts.translation: 可你就这样把我晾在门外...

scripts.text: You must be advanced in martial arts...
scripts.translation: 你的武艺一定已经很高深了...

scripts.text: What the hell do you want?
Training is so tough and I have a long way to go!
scripts.translation: 修行真辛苦，我还有很长的路要走！

scripts.text: I want to know about the skill you used a while ago.
scripts.translation: 我想了解一下你刚才使用的技能。

scripts.text: ............ A rookie like you doesn't need to know.
I have steadily practiced martial arts.
scripts.translation: 我一直在稳扎稳打地修习武术。

scripts.text: I am confident that I will never lose.
So you can beat me, too?
Frankly speaking, I was quite amazed by you.
I had thought that I was strong enough but after seeing you fight, I realized that I was full of conceit.
scripts.translation: 我原以为自己已经足够强大，但看过你的战斗后才发现自己太自负了。

scripts.text: Huuuh~ No matter how strong you are,
you cannot avoid reaching for your true limit.
scripts.translation: 都无法避免触及自身真正的极限。

scripts.text: You are just the person that I expected.
scripts.translation: 你果然就是我期待的人。

scripts.text: Of course, I am a human.
To become stronger is too hard for a mere human.
scripts.translation: 单凭人类之躯，想要变得更强实在太难。

scripts.text: If you want to, just buy better equipment.
scripts.translation: 想变强的话，买更好的装备不就行了。

scripts.text: You mean you're not a human being?

scripts.translation: 对人类来说是不可能的。

scripts.text: I gave up being a human after I chose this way.
scripts.translation: 选择这条道路后，我便舍弃了人类身份。

scripts.text: The way to become a Sura abandoning divine protection.
scripts.translation: 这是舍弃神明庇护、成为修罗的道路。

scripts.text: You won't even have time to take a rest if you choose this way.
scripts.translation: 选择这条道路后，你连休息的时间都不会有。

scripts.text: You'll become a puppet for war...
But I still want to know more.
Why are you so happy about becoming a ghost?
scripts.translation: 成为鬼神有什么好高兴的？

scripts.text: You'll regret it, so just be satisfied with your present life.
scripts.translation: 你会后悔的，还是满足于现在的生活吧。

scripts.text: Well, now that I've met you, I won't live my life this way anymore!
scripts.translation: 既然我已经遇见了你，就不会再这样过下去了！

scripts.text: Hah... you're really making me tired.
Okay, then^f57d7d go and kill 100 Desert Wolves.^000000
scripts.translation: 好吧，那就^f57d7d去杀100只沙漠狼。^000000

scripts.text: After that, I'll think about it again.
scripts.translation: 完成之后，我再考虑看看。

scripts.text: You don't need to look for trouble.
Did you really kill all those wolves?
scripts.translation: 你真的把那些狼全杀了吗？

scripts.text: I figured you'd have given up.
scripts.translation: 我还以为你早就放弃了。

scripts.text: A woman's word is her bond!!
Go to ^f57d7dEl Mes Gorge Southeast of Juno^000000.
scripts.translation: 去^f57d7d朱诺东南方的艾尔梅斯峡谷^000000。

scripts.text: My colleague ^f57d7dBuddy^000000 will be training himself near the center of that area.
scripts.translation: 我的同伴^f57d7d巴迪^000000正在那一带中央附近修行。

scripts.text: Tell him that 'Bruno' sent you there and after that, just suit yourself.
scripts.translation: 告诉他是“布鲁诺”让你来的，之后就看你自己的了。

scripts.text: Hah... you're really making me tired.
Okay, then^f57d7d go and kill 100 Desert Wolves.^000000
scripts.translation: 好吧，那就^f57d7d去杀100只沙漠狼。^000000

scripts.text: Then I'll think about it again.
Go to ^f57d7dEl Mes Gorge Southeast of Juno^000000.
scripts.translation: 去^f57d7d朱诺东南方的艾尔梅斯峡谷^000000。

scripts.text: My colleague ^f57d7dBuddy^000000 will be training himself near the center of that area.
scripts.translation: 我的同伴^f57d7d巴迪^000000正在那一带中央附近修行。

scripts.text: Tell him that 'Bruno' sent you there and after that, just suit yourself.
scripts.translation: 告诉他是“布鲁诺”让你来的，之后就看你自己的了。

scripts.text: Don't you have any presents for your teacher?
I recommend you to reconsider being a Sura.
scripts.translation: 我建议你重新考虑要不要成为修罗。

scripts.text: Sura is strong and cool, but that's not all.
scripts.translation: 修罗强大又帅气，但可不只有这些。

scripts.text: If I need to choose a job again, I will definitely choose Sura.
scripts.translation: 如果让我重新选择职业，我一定还会选修罗。

scripts.text: I don't know why you're here but please don't stand behind me unless you want to die.
scripts.translation: 我不知道你为什么来这里，不过不想死的话，就别站在我身后。

scripts.text: I don't know why you're here but please don't stand behind me unless you want to die.
scripts.translation: 我不知道你为什么来这里，不过不想死的话，就别站在我身后。

scripts.text: Ah! My colleague introduced me to you!
scripts.translation: 啊！是我的同伴介绍你来的！

scripts.text: Anyway, why are you here to see me?
scripts.translation: 不管怎样，你来找我有什么事？

scripts.text: I asked Bruno about her strength, and she recommended me to you.
scripts.translation: 我向布鲁诺打听她的实力，她就推荐我来找你。

scripts.text: That difficult girl... no, just kidding.
scripts.translation: 那个难缠的姑娘...不，开玩笑的。

scripts.text: You must be a special person for her to send you to me.
scripts.translation: 她会把你介绍给我，你一定很特别。

scripts.text: Well, I can't answer your question because I'm in the process of self-training, so I will take you to our master.
scripts.translation: 我现在正在独自修行，没法回答你的问题。我带你去见师父吧。

scripts.text: My master doesn't like noise, so please ^f57d7dwait in the living room silently.^000000
scripts.translation: 师父不喜欢吵闹，请^f57d7d在起居室安静等候。^000000

scripts.text: Are you here to meet my master?
You are not here to see me, aren't you?
{0}, didn't you meet the master yet?
My master doesn't like noise, so please ^f57d7dwait in the living room silently.^000000
scripts.translation: 师父不喜欢吵闹，请^f57d7d在起居室安静等候。^000000

scripts.text: My master doesn't like noise, so please ^f57d7dwait in the living room silently.^000000
scripts.translation: 师父不喜欢吵闹，请^f57d7d在起居室安静等候。^000000

scripts.text: Please wait in the living room at the upper side.
scripts.translation: 请在上方的起居室等候。

scripts.text: I'll show you the way. This way.
He said he has put the world out of his mind and he is a ghost who gave up being a human but he seems to have a lingering desire for the world.
scripts.translation: 他说自己已不再牵挂世事，是个舍弃人身的鬼神，但看起来仍对这个世界有所留恋。

scripts.text: Well, I am also a Sura but I still enjoy traveling and meeting many people~
scripts.translation: 我也是修罗，不过我还是很喜欢四处旅行、结识各种人～

scripts.text: In the old days, my master had one close friend but after becoming a Sura,
scripts.translation: 以前师父有一位挚友，但成为修罗之后，

scripts.text: I heard that he wrote a letter to the friend that he had died.
scripts.translation: 听说他写信告诉那位朋友自己已经死了。

scripts.text: Then he sometimes visits 'the place of memory' secretly.
scripts.translation: 后来他偶尔会偷偷去“回忆之地”。

scripts.text: It would be better not saying that he died and just keep meeting his friend.
scripts.translation: 与其说自己死了，不如继续和朋友见面。

scripts.text: He's a bit of a stick-in-the-mud.
But he is really cool and awesome.
scripts.translation: 不过他真的很帅，也很厉害。

scripts.text: The reason why I keep traveling is to find 'the precious friend' of my master and not to training myself more.
scripts.translation: 我不断旅行，是为了找到师父那位“珍贵的朋友”，而不是为了继续修行。

scripts.text: I feel heavy-hearted when I see my master missing his friend...
scripts.translation: 看到师父思念朋友，我心里也很难受...

scripts.text: It's not... not just for my... master!
scripts.translation: 这...这不只是为了师...师父！

scripts.text: Wow~ I thought you would be knocked out before seeing my master but you are finally here now?
scripts.translation: 哇～我还以为你见到师父前就会被打趴呢，没想到你终于到了？

scripts.text: Anyway you are here now, so I am your immediate superior.
scripts.translation: 总之你既然来了，我就是你的直属上级。

scripts.text: We don't care about your age in our world!
scripts.translation: 在我们这里，可不在乎年龄！

scripts.text: Come again whenever you want to~
I will show you the training course of the dead~
scripts.translation: 我带你看看死者的修行之道～

scripts.text: How did you find this place!
You must have bright eyes to see that you finally came to this room.
scripts.translation: 你眼力不错，终于找到这间屋子了。

scripts.text: You can't become a Sura unless you use all your skill points.
scripts.translation: 必须用完所有技能点，才能成为修罗。

scripts.text: You seem to be heavily burdened. Please remove some of it.
scripts.translation: 你身上似乎带了太多东西，请先卸下一些。

scripts.text: You don't seem to have reached the limit of a human, you still have far to go in order to become Sura.
scripts.translation: 你似乎还没有达到人类的极限，距离成为修罗仍有很长的路要走。

scripts.text: Master! This is a wolf fur coat.
Put it on when it's cold.
Ahhk! That is the wolf I... caught... Uhh.
Do you have something to say, {0}?
You became a member of our family, let's get along together ~
scripts.translation: 你已经是我们的一员了，今后好好相处吧～

scripts.text: Right, I now accept you as my student, too.
scripts.translation: 没错，我现在也正式收你为徒了。

scripts.text: I think you already know it, but to live as a Sura will not be that easy.
scripts.translation: 我想你已经知道，作为修罗生活并不轻松。

scripts.text: I also shut myself off from the world. If there comes a day when we go to the world again, it must be the day when the world needs ghosts for the wars.
scripts.translation: 我也与世隔绝了。若有一天我们再次踏入世间，那一定是世界需要鬼神投身战争之时。

scripts.text: I hope those days will not come but... I'll willingly be the ghost and kill all enemies.
scripts.translation: 我希望那一天永远不会到来...但若真的来临，我愿化作鬼神，消灭所有敌人。

scripts.text: So... please get down from your riding pet!
It is a loss of etiquette on this situation.
scripts.translation: 这种场合骑着坐骑实在失礼。

scripts.text: You should train yourself steadily until that day.
scripts.translation: 在那一天到来之前，你要继续勤加修行。

scripts.text: Once I was also an ordinary young man who traveled a lot and met many friends.
scripts.translation: 我曾经也只是个四处旅行、结交了许多朋友的普通年轻人。

scripts.text: However, as you might have felt, I finally faced my limitation.
scripts.translation: 然而，正如你可能已经感受到的，我最终还是遇到了自己的极限。

scripts.text: Sometimes I wondered 'should I have to give up everything to be more powerful...?'
scripts.translation: 有时我也会想：‘为了变得更强，我是不是必须放弃一切...？’

scripts.text: This is not a place where you can stay.
scripts.translation: 这里不是你能待的地方。
